newsitem.title: ISRAEL: CPC seeks stake in Israel food company.
newsitem.headline: CPC seeks stake in Israel food company.

text.p: CPC International is negotiating with Koor Industries to purchase its 24.5 percent stake in Israel Edible Products Ltd (Tami), a Koor spokesman confirmed to Reuters on Wednesday.
CPC became the major shareholder in Tami when it purchased 51 percent of the food company in 1991.
The remaining 24.5 percent is owned by German-based investor George Faktor.
Financial analysts in Tel Aviv said they expect CPC will attempt to buy Faktor's shares as well.
The spokesman refused to give any further details but said they would be released once the deal is concluded.
He said the sale was part of Koor's strategy to concentrate on the company's core businesses and pull out of others. Koor is Israel's largest industrial concern.
